mechanism: Celecoxib may increase oxybutynin levels through CYP3A4/2D6 inhibition while both drugs have anticholinergic/CNS effects; celecoxib also increases sodium/fluid retention which may worsen urinary retention.
action: Monitor for increased anticholinergic effects (urinary retention, constipation, cognitive changes); consider dose adjustment of oxybutynin or alternative analgesic if symptoms develop.
